## Design

### 2026-11-01: full pomodoro timer with a 2.9 inch e-ink screen and seven screens. idle focus, break etc.

**10h**

full pomodoro timer with a 2.9 inch e-ink screen and seven screens. idle focus, break etc.
three buttons aswell and a long break after 4 session. included power savings. i.e light sleep between screen updates and deep sleep after 3 idle minutes

### 2026-11-01: ![1-startup-splash](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s8FiXfO5yvsIlnF7UyrqT37MWv6hzXsm/3e1abd05f7714e1ee4ff3a5a18c42fa1dd0100e17e2cd7a95e40fba1cb9ffaeb.png)

**5h**

![1-startup-splash](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s8FiXfO5yvsIlnF7UyrqT37MWv6hzXsm/3e1abd05f7714e1ee4ff3a5a18c42fa1dd0100e17e2cd7a95e40fba1cb9ffaeb.png)

the buddy has a speech bubble under its face now. when idle it shows the active preset like deep 50/10 so pressing c visibly does something. while focusing it rotates through phrases like let's go, in the zone, keep going, almost there, and final push in the last minute. during breaks it shows reminders like stretch, drink water, look far away, or breathe, and long breaks say go for a walk. when paused it says take your time. on power-up it displays hi there and the a, b, and c controls for 2.5 seconds before starting the timer, which is skipped when waking from sleep. the word mute is replaced with a small muted speaker icon. below 10% battery the bubble says charge me and the sleep screen shows battery low: charge me. the bubble text was also fixed so it uses the small built-in font instead of switching fonts and cramped text, so every message now fits properly.
